title: Faultline
author: Sotehr
rules:
RULES

Chaos Construction

• Divide the grid into four orthogonally contiguous regions of 9 cells each. Each region contains the digits 1–9 once each. Digits may not repeat in a row or column.

Region Sum Line

• Region borders divide blue lines into segments with equal sums. Adjacent cells joined orthogonally on a line are in the same region; cells joined diagonally on a line are in different regions.

Non-Consecutive

• Orthogonally adjacent cells may not contain consecutive digits.

Black Kropki

• Cells separated by a black dot have one digit double the other.

Expected Difficulty: 3

Play [Faultline]

NOTES

For the Setting Saturday prompt by Dorlir. I may attempt a 9x9 of this in the future!
solutionCode: All digits contained in the region that includes row 2/column 2, from top to bottom and left to right.
